Companies House (UK): GET https://api.company-information.service.gov.uk/search/companies?q={term} , HTTP Basic with the API key as username and a blank password, free key, 600 requests per 5 minutes (https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/developer-guidelines). NZBN (NZ): GET https://api.business.govt.nz/gateway/nzbn/v5/entities?search-term={term} , header Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key, free, rate limit NOT documented, and the exact query-string token could not be confirmed from the JS-rendered OpenAPI definition (https://portal.api.business.govt.nz/api/nzbn). KVK (NL): name search GET https://api.kvk.nl/api/v2/zoeken?naam={name} with header apikey is PAID and excludes private use; the only free route is the number-keyed Open Dataset GET https://opendata.kvk.nl/api/v1/hvds/basisbedrijfsgegevens/kvknummer/{kvknummer} , no auth, 1 request per minute per IP (https://developers.kvk.nl/documentation/open-dataset-basis-bedrijfsgegevens-api). INPI RNE (France): NO documented free search API - bulk SFTP and dataset APIs only (https://data.inpi.fr/content/editorial/Acces_API_Entreprises); the official free no-key alternative is GET https://recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr/search?q={term} , 7 requests per second per IP, documented at https://recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr/docs . ASIC (Australia): NO public search API, web-only via ASIC Connect, DSP applications closed until 2027, XML not JSON (https://www.asic.gov.au/online-services/information-for-intermediaries/application-programming-interfaces-apis). CIPC (South Africa): NO API at all, web-only ENTERPRISE SEARCH (https://eservices.cipc.co.za/). Only Companies House and NZBN are genuinely free, key-based, JSON, name-searchable. Do not invent endpoints for INPI, ASIC or CIPC; mark them unsupported with the documented reason. Gate 5 still applies to every evidence line: copy from the downloaded artifact, never type it.
